# Bruno, the dog

Bruno is a four-year-old Labrador mix. His vet is Dr. Weber in the practice on
Lindenallee, open weekdays from 8 to 18. In an emergency at night, call the
animal clinic in the city, which is open around the clock.

Vaccinations: rabies every three years, last in September 2025; the combined
vaccine against distemper and parvovirus every year in spring. The tick tablet
is given on the first of every month from March to October.

He gets 300 grams of dry food a day in two meals, at seven and at six. No
chocolate, grapes or onions. Since his stomach trouble last winter he only gets
the grain-free food, and treats count towards the daily amount.
